statusSemantics.runtimeHit: not-observed does not mean absent or excluded
statusSemantics.replacementApplied: Only runtime observer candidate-applied events establish object binding, not visual acceptance
statusSemantics.runtimeArguments: Observed-code parameters or explicitly marked candidates; no new manifest types defined

routes.arguments: key=_key; jsonKey=replace_json_key ?? MtiText.default_json_key; text container=SpineAnim/<key>.atlas; image container=SpineAnim/<key>; image_key=<key>
routes.cache: BetobetoManager.OTex; SvTexture.SpAtlasAsset/SpDataAsset; SpineViewer.ORsvData; MTISpine.OSpDataAsset keyed by JSON
consumers: SvTexture render texture and dirt material
routes.release: SvTexture.releaseAtlasData removes _SV load keys; releaseTexture releases rendered image; MTISpine.Dispose clears JSON cache.
limitations: 37 groups use generic key + jsonKey; no four-pose restriction in the plugin.
Runtime hits, visible output and shared cache isolation not verified in this investigation.
Multi-page atlas is not supported by the current replacement implementation.

routes.arguments: asset_key is the constructor/container scope; load_key is an ownership token, not an image key. Null image_key remains null in the v2 target, though MTIOneImage resolves its own image_key to basename(key).
routes.cache: MTI.OCon[asset_key]; MTIOneImage.LImage_; MTI.OImg; PxlCharacter.AExternalTexture; MTRX image cache
routes.release: remLoadKey on last owner invokes Dispose; base Dispose unloads bundle and OImg; derived Dispose clears LImage_.
limitations: Hook returns before async texture arrival in MTRX callers.
Changing MImage.Tx is not evidence that all PxlsTexture consumers were rebound.
Only the main image has an existing replacement entry; extra pages must be investigated separately.

routes.arguments: MTI constructor key (recoverable exactly from resources_path) + LoadImage path; title key_noel/difficulty use MTI_title.
routes.cache: MTI.OImg[path] holds MImage; SceneTitleTemp.MIpic/MIdifficulty and MeshDrawer hold consumers.
routes.release: SceneTitleTemp.OnDestroy -> releaseLoadedMti; MTI.Dispose clears OImg and unloads bundle.
limitations: Direct LoadImage is observed only; P03 will implement replacement and retained consumers.
wplmode_ consumer is not confirmed in the examined ver030g assemblies.

routes.arguments: Requested path + actual/requested objectType. Generic Resources.Load<T> delegates to typed overload; do not derive path from Object.name.
routes.cache: Unity Resources cache; ReplacementRuntime.resourceRecords; caller retains returned Unity object.
routes.release: Unity unload/lifetime; ReplacementRuntime disposes its own replacement objects on deactivation.
limitations: Current Sprite.Create uses FullRect; packed rotation and original mesh/UV require P03 audit.
Two catalog Sprites reside in AssetBundles; no Resources consumer was found. Do not assign fabricated Resources paths.
Long-lived consumers and switching from original to replacement require game validation.

routes.arguments: MTI(pxls_path).LoadBytes(basename(pxls_path)); external asset_key=pxls_path + .bytes.texture_0; image_key omitted/null; image_mti_load_key goes to addLoadKey.
routes.cache: PxlsLoader character cache by pxl_name; PxlCharacter images/frames; external_png_header set to pxls_path by MTRX.
routes.release: PxlsLoader.disposeCharacter -> PxlCharacter.Destroy; MTIOneImage owners release load keys separately.
limitations: A catalog-derived asset key is a candidate until a source caller or runtime arguments link the specific group.
No method named MTRX.loadMtiPxcTexture was found in this baseline; M2DBase contains additional image loading helpers.
Character return may precede image decoding.

routes.arguments: PxlImage.pChar; serialized uint id + double id2; role I/P. Packed pages decode through PxlsImgAtlas and assign PxlImage.AtlasI/AtlasP; page ordinal, image_index and img_type are observed separately.
routes.cache: PxlCharacter.OImg[PxlImageId]; PxlImage.I/P or AtlasI/AtlasP; frames/layers retain image references.
routes.release: PxlCharacter.Destroy -> PxlImage.Destroy; external page lifecycle is separate.
limitations: external_png_header is a diagnostic observation, not a finalized source identity.
_icons_ttr bypasses MTRX: NelTTRBase uses MTI_mgm_ttr.Load<TextAsset>(_icons_ttr.pxls).
noel_bassrobe is absent from MTR.Anoel_pxls in this baseline; actual caller remains pending.
%IMGV_SECTION% and packed atlases are handled by the game, not reimplemented here.

routes.arguments: Page 0=MTIOneImage.Image; when bundle asset count is 2, getPxlMtiParts changes trailing _0 to _1 and calls LoadImage. Observe actual array indices and null pages.
routes.cache: PxlCharacter.AExternalTexture[] and PxlsTexture.Image; AtlasI/AtlasP point into these pages.
limitations: Bundle asset count is not guaranteed to equal texture page count; imported Sprite objects are a relevant edge case.
No blanket mask-page mapping is inferred; role and consumers must be confirmed per page.
Mixed embedded/external and vector-packed content is not declared fully replaceable.

routes.arguments: SpvLoader dir defaults Fatal/; atlas name=_atlas_key ?? _key; image container=dir+atlas name with image_key=atlas name; text container=dir+atlas name+.atlas; JSON=_key.
routes.release: SpvLoader.destruct removes _FT_<json> load keys and destroys own materials; viewers release attached MTI ownership.
limitations: Current portrait SvTexture adapter does not cover this path.
fatal_nusi_1 uses JSON fatal_nusi_1 with atlas/image fatal_nusi_0.
The mti-one-image entry can observe a shared image, but this does not prove correct full Spine replacement.

routes.arguments: Current base_spine selects SpvLoader; ikey selects Atlas.FindRegion directly, even when no skeleton attachment references it.
routes.cache: Shared SpvLoader atlas/texture; FtSpecialDrawerPicture retains region and material.
limitations: cuts_nightingale_0_0 noel_peeping__0000/0001/0002 have PICT script evidence.
No independent atlas-only entry exists; damage_backvoreenemy consumer is still unresolved.

routes.arguments: Editor file picker -> NKT.readSpecificFileBinary -> ByteArray decoder; decoder reads name and chr_name. AddChr obtains external source page 0 and optional parts page 1.
routes.release: releaseAppliedImage and destruct; original source textures remain owned by PXL.
limitations: Known reader is an editor path; no proven automatic StreamingAssets/mobpcc game consumer for the five files.
Names containing Noel are not character membership evidence.
Decoded content name is not a stable source filename. All five remain pending for P07.

routes.arguments: Tutorial: Tuto_mp4/<movie> container + movie_filename to MTI.Load<VideoClip>. Map effects: Effect_mp4/<movie>. VideoPlayer.source=VideoClip, not URL.
consumers: FillBlockMovieTuto time events and loop handling
routes.release: closeMovie stops player/removes owned load key; OnDestroy releases RTx; M2UnstbMovie.Dispose stops and releases owner.
limitations: FillBlockMovie isLooping follows fade_time<=0; FillBlockMovieTuto has time events; both shown paths set audio output to None.
Player state and clip presence are observations, not replacement/playback acceptance.
The two excluded map-effect videos remain listed separately.
